decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the western wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - APPROVAL

It is considered that the proposed erection of a single-storey rear extension because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable and complementary to the visual amenity of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the living conditions of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  The development is in accordance with REG (2002) policies and ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003 and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
